title: Unknown occupancy codes
text:
Unknown occupancy codes

Touchstone
 supports the following unknown
 occupancy class code.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and limitations for specific
 models, refer to the model documentation that is available on the 
Client Portal
.

| Occupancy code | Category | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 300 | Unknown | The occupancy is unknown. |

Note:
 In some models, the construction and occupancy class code combination
 
100
-300 is invalid, and
 
Touchstone
 remaps this combination to
 100-311. Analysis logs note when the combination 100-300 has been remapped to 100-311,
 where 
311
 is General
 Commercial.
